items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 27 at 12:39AM PST until November 28 at 1:00AM PST by NWS Portland OR
items.description:
* WHAT...Seas 10 to 13 ft at 12 to 15 seconds and north winds 5
to 15 kt expected.

* WHERE...Coastal Waters from Cape Shoalwater to Florence out 60
NM.

* WHEN...Until 1 AM PST Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
